options.command:
set -eu
consumer="${GEOSPEC_INSTALLED_CONSUMER_ROOT:?Run scripts:prepare-geospec-test-consumer first}"
export GEOSPEC_WORKSPACE_ROOT="${NX_WORKSPACE_ROOT:?}"
export GEOSPEC_INSTALLED_BACKEND=native
export GEOSPEC_F1_OUTPUT="$GEOSPEC_WORKSPACE_ROOT/out/artifacts/geospec-test-consumer/f1-vitest.json"
export GEOSPEC_VITEST_OUTPUT="$GEOSPEC_WORKSPACE_ROOT/out/artifacts/geospec-test-consumer/m3-vitest.json"
export GEOSPEC_VITEST_CACHE="$GEOSPEC_WORKSPACE_ROOT/out/artifacts/geospec-test-consumer/vitest-cache"
unset GEOSPEC_CAMPAIGN_INPUTS GEOSPEC_CAMPAIGN_INPUTS_SHA256 GEOSPEC_VITEST_CAMPAIGN GEOSPEC_F1_RESULTS GEOSPEC_F1_ADMISSIONS
mkdir -p "$GEOSPEC_WORKSPACE_ROOT/out/artifacts/geospec-test-consumer"
node "$consumer/node_modules/vitest/vitest.mjs" run --root "$consumer/host-tests/f1-public-a1" --config "$consumer/host-tests/f1-public-a1/vitest.config.mjs"
node "$consumer/node_modules/vitest/vitest.mjs" run --root "$consumer/host-tests" --config "$consumer/host-tests/m3-corpus/vitest.config.mjs"
